surfaces.part: nettle clump (upright leaf blades and stems)

answer.evidence: The silhouette is a plant clump seen from the side. Thin blades and stems rise from row 3 and widen to a 15px base at rows 11-15. The column scan shows only vertical dark-to-light green strokes, such as x=5 at rows 9-15 and x=8 and x=12 at rows 11-15. There is no horizontal band, front-edge line, eave shadow, ellipse or any other plate-like surface seen from above. A flat object should read as a plate lying on the ground, and this is an upright standing plant, so the kind does not match and no top surface is shown.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny sprite of a few green blades, smaller than one 16x16 tile. It is not a 4x3-tile ground patch like the grass and paving references. The measured facts give 0 visible tones per tile because the piece is under one tile, so I judged by eye. It has only 5 distinct colours in total, against 80 for the reference grass. It shows about 3 green steps with a dark green edge tint (0% neutral edge pixels). There is no ground base, no soil or grass grain and no clump variation. The references carry about 3 visible tones per tile on grass and 7 on paving, with full-surface texture. The candidate reads as a thin sparse sprite, not a surface, and would look much thinner and flatter than the references beside them.

surfaces.part: nettle leaf clump (blades and stalks, drawn upright)

answer.evidence: The silhouette widens from 1px at row 3 to 15px at rows 12-15. It is made of upright vertical blades and stalks with pointed tips (rows 3-9), standing on a denser mass (rows 10-15). The column scan shows vertical runs of the same colour (x=8 and x=12 are one dark run at rows 11-15) and no horizontal band, edge line, eave shadow or ellipse. Nothing shows a horizontal surface seen from above. It is a front-facing view of upright plants, not a flat plate lying on the ground, so the 'flat' kind does not match the drawing.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny tuft of grass blades, well under one 16x16 tile, on a dark background.
